title: Shopper Relief on the Groom Club Monthly Early Termination Fee
content:
Customers who shop with Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders receive a shopper relief on the early termination fee when they cancel Groom Club Monthly at the Tailwise Grooming Salon.

**Rule.** The shopper relief on the early termination fee follows the customer's charged Tailwise order lines dated within the last 12 whole calendar months, returns and refunds not reducing them:

- a charged total of at least 600.00 over at least 3 lines gives 30 percent;
- a charged total of at least 250.00 but less than 600.00 over at least 3 lines gives 15 percent;
- any other case gives none.

**Combination table**

| Charged total of order lines in the last 12 whole calendar months | Charged lines | Shopper relief |
|---|---|---|
| 600.00 or more | 3 or more | 30 percent |
| 250.00 to 599.99 | 3 or more | 15 percent |
| 600.00 or more | 1 or 2 | none |
| 250.00 to 599.99 | 1 or 2 | none |
| under 250.00 | any | none |

The total is the sum of the amounts charged on the order lines of the customer's Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, each charged line counting once; a later return or refund of a line does not reduce the total or the count.

**Applying it.** The shopper relief reduces the early termination fee once and does not touch club late-cancellation charges. Where the early termination fee carries more than one percentage relief, the reliefs are first added into one relief percentage, never above 100 percent, and that combined percentage reduces the early termination fee once; the reliefs do not act one after the other.

**Examples (hypothetical customers)**

- Four charged lines totalling 612.40, one of them since returned: 30 percent.
- Two charged lines totalling 700.00: none, fewer than 3 lines.
- Five charged lines totalling 250.00: 15 percent.
- Three charged lines totalling 249.99: none.
